    Thornfield Loom (2018)

    Thornfield Loom is two people and one borrowed jacquard loom in the Olneyville mill district.

    Marisol Quennebeck co-founded Thornfield Loom in Providence in 2017 to keep small textile mills scheduling their own looms.
